content.short: Copy trading is the heart of BingX, a global exchange where users mirror leaderboard traders on spot, futures and grid bots.
content.description: BingX has operated since 2018 and built its product around social trading. Users browse a public leaderboard, pick a trader and copy their spot, futures or grid bot positions automatically. They can also trade hundreds of assets directly. The exchange runs web, iOS and Android apps in many languages and has sponsorship deals with Scuderia Ferrari and Chelsea FC. The platform has expanded into TradFi markets such as stocks, indices, metals and forex, adds AI strategy tools for building bots, and lets beginners practise with demo trading on virtual funds.
